subject: Re: Conference schedule
text:
Hi Prof. Lee,

Sorry for the late reply, I totally dropped the ball on this one. Following up on your note, I rechecked your message and realized the handout never got attached, which is a classic me move. I have finally got it ready and popped it on the shared drive so you don't have to chase me.

The timing got away from me because I was wrangling rooms and coffee orders at the last minute, and things fell apart until this afternoon. Sorry again for making you wait; it is not how I roll when things are tight. The original file also had the wrong venue map, so I fixed that while I was at it.

Could you give it a quick glance before Friday? If anything looks off, ping me and I'll sort it before the session. Really appreciate you keeping things from going off the rails. I owe you a coffee.

Thanks,
Morgan
